profile.headline: Founder of The French Theater Project; Ex-Googler (Search, DeepMind)
profile.summary:
I am a cultural entrepreneur and a lover of French language and literature. I am also a retired artificial intelligence researcher and software engineer, with a 32-year industry career behind me.

I am the Founder and General Manager of the French Theater Project, an early-stage Boston-based theater company presenting live, contemporary French theater to audiences in America. Details at www.frenchtheaterproject.com .

I created and operate the Theater Club at the French Library of Boston and Cambridge (frenchlibrary.org/french-library-theater-club) and blog about French language and literature at www.monsieurmiller.com.

In 2026 I retired from the tech industry following an 18 year tenure at Google DeepMind / Google Search, and an overall 32-year career working as an AI researcher, software engineer, and manager. I was an expert artificial intelligence practitioner with extensive experience in the domains of text generation, deep neural networks, internet search, speech and language processing, and bioinformatics. I led small and medium software projects and have experience with all phases from product conception through delivery and support. I employed and invented algorithms in machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical inference, search, optimization, and large data problems. I have published 11 research papers, have delivered numerous invited lectures, and hold 5 US patents.
